name: keysrs
description: Agent surface for Keysrs, the local Mac API-key vault: the keysrs skill and the `keys mcp` server. Needs Keysrs.app on macOS (brew install --cask gshost1/keysrs/keysrs, or keysrs.com).

interface.shortDescription: Scoped, Touch ID-approved API-key grants for agents
interface.longDescription: Keysrs keeps provider API keys in the macOS Keychain behind Touch ID and hands agents scoped, expiring gateway grants instead of keys. This plugin adds the keysrs skill and the `keys mcp` server. It needs Keysrs.app installed on macOS (brew install --cask gshost1/keysrs/keysrs, or keysrs.com).
defaultPrompt: List my Keysrs keys and show gateway status.
Ask Keysrs for a 30-minute grant for this project.
